description.zh: 账户新密码，密码格式参考密码策略。
description.en: The new password of the account. For more information about the password format, see the "Password Policies" topic.

description.zh:
强制修改密码状态，默认不启用，取值可选范围：
- enabled：开启。
- disabled：禁用。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable forcible password change upon first logon. Default value: disabled. Valid values:

*   enabled
*   disabled

description.zh:
密码通知渠道列表。密码通知渠道取值可选范围：
- email：邮件。
- sms：短信。
description.en: The methods for receiving password notifications.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam update-user-password --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --user-id user_d6sbsuumeta4h66ec3il7yxxxx --password 123456 --password-forced-update-status enabled --user-notification-channels email --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam UpdateUserPassword --region cn-hangzhou --PasswordForcedUpdateStatus enabled --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --UserId user_d6sbsuumeta4h66ec3il7yxxxx --UserNotificationChannels.1 email --Password 123456 --method POST --force
